sources.dataset: Monthly LDT beached and number of ships beached
sources.scope: Historical monthly values as rendered at acquisition; original release timestamps and revision history are unavailable

caveats: The demolition table reports 70 records at acquisition, including beaching dates from 2020 through 2026. It is a current-state table, not proof of a complete historical arrivals census.
The monthly analysis history for 2016-2026 was confirmed through the public unauthenticated year selector, but past values may be revised and no point-in-time release archive was found.
August 2026 is partial at acquisition; September-December 2026 zeros are future placeholders and must not be modeled as observations.
AlangToday states that it takes no legal responsibility for the accuracy or completeness of its data.
The site does not specify a unit for propeller shaft diameter on the public table; the field is retained only as source text.
